description: Pure-code short-term reversal (Jegadeesh 1990, JF 45:881-898; Lehmann 1990, QJE 105:1-28): each week buy the two sector SPDR ETFs with the lowest 5-bar return relative to the cross-section and hold 5 bars; long-only (loser leg). Industry-level returns may continue instead (Moskowitz & Grinblatt 1999), so this may be a negative baseline. Zero LLM tokens.
output_character: weekly long calls on the two biggest relative losers among 11 sector ETFs, 5-bar hold, ATR disaster stop
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
author: MarketMind (pure code, owner decision 2026-09-29)
